content.text: What’s going on? Are you on furlough?
I must have completely missed that text on Easter. I was on furlough last week, now I’m knee-deep in this Galarraga project
How are you and the fam doing?

Oh no problem...I hope all is well. What is the Galarraga project? We are ok...working hard trying to get Jimmy John’s Field going with proper approvals and social distancing. I think we definitely have the best chance of playing with fans of any pro baseball venue in the country.
Let me know whenever you think it’s best to write a story. I am tied up until Monday with this and then I have a furlough week before the draft.
The Galarraga thing is an oral history and then a feature on Joyce, 10 years later
How close are you guys to knowing if you can play or not and when? Like, with MLB so uncertain, I think it’s a good time

Sounds great...I’ll be in touch on it. We are shooting for mid June but a lot of hurdles. We have a 200 page plan for reopening into the Gov.  we have far fewer impediments than MLB. We only have one owner, one ballpark, no travel, no unions.
